mainEntity.name: What causes stucco to crack and chip?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stucco can crack and chip due to several factors, including foundation movement, seismic activity, water intrusion, and improper installation. Minor hairline cracks are common and often superficial, resulting from normal expansion and contraction. However, larger cracks, especially those with visible damage or crumbling, can indicate more significant underlying issues like structural shifts or prolonged moisture exposure, requiring prompt repair to prevent further damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco cracks and chips are caused by foundation movement, seismic activity, water intrusion, and improper installation, as well as normal expansion and contraction.
